title: Maker-Breaker Sabotage Game
summary: The Maker-Breaker sabotage game is played on a graph $G$ by Runner and Blocker. They play in turns, Runner first moves along a not yet traversed edge from her current position, afterwards Blocker removes one edge. The goal of Runner is to visit as many vertices of $G$ as possible, Blocker's goal is opposite. Assuming that both players use optimal strategies, the number of vertices visited by Runner determines an invariant called the sabotage number ${\rm sab}(G)$ of $G$.
